blocked.reason: PoreSpy tortuosity_fd requires OpenPNM 3.6.1, whose scipy>=1.16.2 and pandas>=2.3.2 conflict with the fixed scipy1.15.3/pandas2.3.0 baseline. A separately approved complete solver environment/native identity and flux-convergence acceptance are not available; no main-environment replacement or bridge placeholder authored.

Reaktoro v2.13.0 source commit 3c5838e7c0ed2931ad152176414cb786311dbe47 is established, but no fixed CPU binary/ABI lock plus licensed offline thermodynamic-database content hash has been supplied. An auditable fixed equilibrium database/model binding is mandatory; no arbitrary database fetch or unpinned native runner is registered.

Same Reaktoro native/database blockers as equilibrium, plus a version-bound built-in rate-law parameter database, mineral-area convention and independent kinetic reference are not frozen. User-supplied code callbacks or an authored replacement rate kernel are forbidden; no registered placeholder.

Official run_string and advection/RUN_CELLS workflow are known, but no pinned IPhreeqc native build/hash, compatible PhreeqPy source commit and licensed phreeqc.dat content identity are established. The existing JSON-only bridge does not supply those identities or bounded native lifecycle. Arbitrary PHREEQC/BASIC inputs remain prohibited.

Reviewed GSTools 1.7.0 CondSRF returns kriging mean plus pointwise variance-scaled unconditional field. That does not in general reproduce joint conditional covariance. For unit exponential covariance conditioned at x=0, target x=-1,+1 has true conditional cross-covariance zero, while pointwise rescaling yields exp(-2)*(1-exp(-2))>0. A resource uncertainty ensemble cannot be represented as exact joint conditional simulation without an independently validated maintained fix/alternative; no local kernel substitution.

The authoritative tutorial imports the separate gempy_plugins topology module. Its current repository exists and declares EUPL-1.2, but a reviewed immutable plugin commit/release and a verified binding to the selected GemPy/engine 2026.0.3 model layout have not been established. Core GemPy's license/version cannot stand in for this plugin; generic voxel labels are not substituted for its geobody topology kernel.

Thermobar v.1.0.75 commit c1978e87f073902778b5589bd2b3b6adfd6de695 has a nonstandard LICENSE.txt requiring written author permission for GUI use and additional citation/payment terms. This application must not label it ordinary MIT or presume wrapper/GUI permission. Calibration-domain acceptance and an independent published P-T reference also remain pending; not registered.
